asset.does_not_imply: PACTA-v2 gate mechanism failure, SCB transport failure, task-utility failure, or external-validity failure
asset.scope: PACTA-v2 fresh six-template policy-surface Pilot only

lineage.PACTA_v11: projection operationalization/gate realization stop; separate and excluded

scientific_belief_update.increase: Replicated downstream-policy action distributions yielded a non-degenerate 3/6 gate on fresh templates.
scientific_belief_update.decrease: The complete final-policy measurement packet did not realize under the strict no-retry contract.
scientific_belief_update.withhold: No PACTA-v2 effect, utility, confirmatory, or external-validity claim.

asset.institutional_lesson: When the scientific claim concerns behavioral transport, a standalone semantic projector may be a poor proxy for the downstream policy. Counterfactual actionability should be measured at the policy surface itself and separated from same-condition stochasticity.
asset.measurement_lesson: Persist a provider response and its model metadata before parsing. Under a strict no-retry contract, parser failure must remain auditable without reissuing the scientific request.
asset.reusable_precheck: Use a write-before-parse response journal and inject malformed-response fixtures to verify that raw text, response ID, model identity, prompt hash, and parser error all survive atomically.
asset.reopen_condition: Do not retry or resume this Pilot. Any new measurement run or independent carrier requires explicit human authorization.
